player_prompt.intro:
I ye jɛgɛ {player_id} ye Chopsticks. Ni a ka tɔnɔ, chɛra kelen ye:
  + Kale:  '[attack M O]'  ka M=bolo ye (0 walima 1), O=sababolo ye (0 walima 1).
    - Sababolo ye kɔnɔ bɔɲɛna bolo ye; ni a >=5, a bɛɛ 0.
  + Faraba:   '[split L R]'  ka kɛɲɛ bolo ye kɔnɔ L ani R (L+R = bolo ye kɔnɔ).
Kɛɲɛ kelen ye o kɔmɛriw ye.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: A jugu bolo {opp_idx} ye sa ban.
invalid_move.split_sum: A ka kan k'a tilancɛ kɛ {total} ye.
invalid_move.split_no_change: A be komi i bolow ka teli k'i sɛgɛn.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kɔmɛriw ye tɛ. Kɛɲɛ “[attack M O]” walima “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} kɛ {opp_id}’s kɩlɩŋga {opp_idx}: ɛtɩ kɛ  {opp_val} mɛ  {new_val}.

outcome.win: A tigi bolo fila bɛɛ ka kan k'a faga.
